infobox.usage: - Unlocks the door to the laboratory experiment's area (G12) in The Lab. - Unlocks the door to Kruglov's office (R22) in The Lab. - Unlocks the safe in Kruglov's office (R22) in The Lab. - Unlocks the safe in the locked bedroom inside the Cardinal apartment on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black) (Black) is a Keycard in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A United Security-issued TerraGroup Labs top-level administration keycard.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text:
- This is a required location for the quest Following the Bread Crumbs
- This is a required location for the story chapter The Ticket if the player did not refuse to work with Mr. Kerman.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- On Cultists
- On The Goons
- In Rare valuables crates

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text:
- On Partisan
- At the three-story dorms in the "marked room"
- At the "giving tree" behind the "Old Gas Station"

sections.heading: Reserve
sections.text:
- On Glukhar
- In the "marked rooms" RB-BK, RB-PKPM and RB-VO

sections.heading: Streets of Tarkov
sections.text:
- On Kaban

- In the "marked room" at Chekannaya 13

sections.heading: The Lab
sections.text:
- In Kruglov's office (R22) and the safe inside of it
- In the laboratory block (G22), sitting next to a computer workstation. TerraGroup Labs keycard (Green) is required for entry.

- Room O11, in front of the telephone on the desk with the computer, across from the toxic waste spill that's covered by the large orange dome.

- In O11 on the large table of scientific supplies

sections.heading: The Lab
sections.text:
- Laboratory experiment's area (G12) on the first level.

- Kruglov's office (R22) and its safe on the second level.

sections.heading: Streets of Tarkov
sections.text: - Keycard panel behind the painting for the locked safe in the locked bedroom inside of apartment 2 on the second floor of the Cardinal apartment complex at Streets of Tarkov. A Cardinal apartment key is required to access it. Opening the safe consumes no uses.

sections.heading: The Lab
sections.text:
- Laboratory experiment's area:
  - 1x Medcase
  - Stimulants
  - LEDX Skin Transilluminator spawns

- Kruglov's office:
  - 1x PC block
  - Valuables
  - Info items
  - Keycards
  - Advanced Electronic Materials textbook spawns on the desk
  - Silicon Optoelectronic Integrated Circuits textbook spawns on the desk
  - Folder with intelligence on Norvinsk region facilities

- Kruglov's safe:
  - Valuables
  - Intelligence folder
  - TerraGroup "Blue Folders" materials
  - Keycards
  - Cardinal apartment key spawn location. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid.

sections.heading: Streets of Tarkov
sections.text:
- Cardinal apartment locked bedroom safe:
  - Valuables
  - Info items
  - Transcript of conversation with Ms. A.
